newsitem.title: USA: Scitex expects deeper Q3 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Scitex expects deeper Q3 operating loss.

text.p: Scitex Corp Ltd said Friday that it expects to post an operating loss in the third quarter greater than the $11 million it reported in this year's second quarter.
The company said the loss in this year's third quarter is "significantly greater" that the previous quarter's loss.
Scitex attributed part of the loss to sales revenues for its graphic arts unit that fell "far short" of expectations, as well as facility closings.
The company said it intends to take an unspecified charge in the third quarter to account for the cost of the cutbacks. That period's results are expected to be released in early November, it said.

In this year's second quarter, the company reported a net loss of $5.97 million, or $0.14 per share, on revenues of $190.2 million, compared to a net profit of $2.14 million, or $0.05 per share, on revenues of $180.5 million in the 1995 second quarter.
In the 1995 third quarter, Scitex reported a net loss of $36.4 million, or $0.85 per share, on revenues of $184.2 million.
Scitex, which is based in Herzlia, Israel, develops, manufactures and markets visual information communication products for the graphic arts, digital printing and digital video markets.
